routes.POST /: AG-UI RunAgentInput -> SSE RUN_STARTED ... RUN_FINISHED/RUN_ERROR (add_langgraph_fastapi_endpoint, path '/')

runtime.auth: every non-/health path requires header x-openbot-agent-token == MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN (hmac.compare_digest; 401 otherwise)
runtime.tool_callback: POST {OPENBOT_TOOL_URL} where OPENBOT_TOOL_URL is the FULL callback endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/agent-tools/call); the agent POSTs it verbatim with NO path appended (verified in vendored tool_runtime._call_tool; helper tool_callback_url() is the single suffix-attachment point). Header x-openbot-agent-token == AGENT_TOOL_TOKEN, body {name, args, run: <openbotRun assertion>}; redirects never followed; callback refusal becomes a model-visible ToolMessage, never a 500
runtime.ownership: deployment-owned tools execute via callback; surface-owned calls (not in openbotDeploymentTools) END the run for the surface to execute/resume; unoffered calls yield RUN_ERROR naming the refusal, never silent drop
runtime.privacy: openbotRun assertion + deployment set travel in the request ContextVar only: stripped from forwarded props, never checkpointed, never in model messages (proven by test_run_secrets_never_reach_model_or_events); durable cross-run memory is owned by home self-hosted Intelligence, not by the ephemeral MemorySaver in main.py

env.AGENT_TOOL_TOKEN: required: credential for the deployment tool callback
env.BOT_PROVIDER: optional override of spec bots row (openai|anthropic|google per PROVIDER_IDS; unknown kept as typed and reported unsupported by config_check)
env.BOT_MODEL: optional model override (may carry provider:model prefix per upstream main.py)
env.provider_keys: OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY per spec key_variable; key may be omitted only when the matching base-URL override is explicitly set (local Ollama/gateway route)
env.OPENAI_BASE_URL: optional override; local-Ollama route is BOT_PROVIDER=openai + OPENAI_BASE_URL=<ollama>/v1 + OPENAI_API_KEY=ollama (all three required; URL alone is not bootable). Host default http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1; IMAGE runs MUST use a container-reachable endpoint (host.docker.internal on Desktop, host gateway on Linux). See runtime-local-model-contract.json.
env.OPENBOT_TOOL_URL: FULL deployment callback endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/agent-tools/call); POSTed verbatim, never extended
env.CHATGPT_AUTH_FILE: optional signed-in ChatGPT plan store path (plan-token path only; not wired unless the operator mounts it)
env.OPENAI_API_KEY: ollama dummy for the local Ollama route (route-generated; documented non-secret placeholder; the SDK refuses keyless construction) OR the real provider key for remote providers (explicit operator input, never invented)

readiness.config_check: structural only (tokens present, provider in spec, key-or-base-URL set). ok == container would boot and resolve a model. It does NOT mean inference works.
readiness.readiness_check: config ok AND live-gated probe (cheap TCP probe of loopback endpoints only; remote endpoints reported unknown, never probed without consent) AND tokens present. Missing license/keys/hardware stay honest NEEDS_INPUT operator gates; Intelligence/license/entitlement delegated to Task A doctor, never guessed here.
